description: This PHP class defines the LeaveRequestModel which acts as a data transfer object (DTO) or API model for the LeaveRequest entity in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It uses traits and annotations to handle serialization, filtering, and attribute naming for API responses related to leave requests.

classes.name: LeaveRequestModel
classes.description: A model class representing leave request data for API responses, built from the LeaveRequest entity and including filtering and serialization configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LeaveRequestModel with a LeaveRequest entity, setting up entity reference, filters, and attribute mappings.
